title: The Power Progression
coreMove: Match the power you pursue to the firm stage and the window where that power can still form.
sourcePressure: Power forms fit stages: counter-positioning and cornered resource in origination; scale economies, network economies, and switching costs in take-off; process power and branding in stability. Timing matters because missed windows narrow later options.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A firm can pick any power at any time if leaders want it enough.

sourceAnchors.name: origination, take-off, and stability
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar gives these stages and maps typical powers to each stage
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The progression is a timing discipline: some powers are built before the market is obvious, some only after demand begins to run.
